instruction: I got some Splitwise group invitations over phone text messages yesterday. If their number is in my phone contact book, accept it, otherwise delete those messages.
notes: Two Splitwise invitation texts from yesterday (2023-05-17) are assumed: one whose sender number is in the contact book (accept via splitwise.accept_group_invitation with the parsed invitation code) and one whose sender is unknown (delete via phone.delete_text_message); this matches the 9-call reference length. Static relational facts in :init (message-sender, message-code, code-for-group, sender-in-contacts, invitation-received-yesterday) encode hidden world truth and are only usable once the knowledge predicates (messages-searched, contact-checked) have been established by phone.search_text_messages (query 'splitwise', date filtered client-side on created_at) and phone.search_contacts (query = sender phone number). Accept requires sender-in-contacts, delete requires its negation, so no wrong action is possible. supervisor.complete_task takes the joined group and deleted message as non-API record parameters so its precondition is exactly the lifted goal conjunction; it is called without an answer.
